phase_name: DECISION GATE -- Measure Narrow Impossible-Assertion Detector Feasibility

objectives.description: Write throwaway probe script in scratchpad

objectives.note: FAILED. The exact ERE from the plan did not detect the known contradiction (line 353's absence-assertion 'does **not** contain REFUSE or the word "refused"' is split by markdown bold **not**, which breaks the literal substring match for 'does not contain'). The probe instead produced an unrelated false hit: the backtick literal `[REFUSE]` appearing twice (line 355 vs line 358), which is not a contradiction -- it is the same tag mentioned twice consistently.

objectives.description: PRECISION TEST over existing specs/**/plans/*.md and specs/**/reports/*.md
objectives.note: Corpus = 2711 files (find specs -path */plans/*.md -o -path */reports/*.md). Flagged (HITS>0) = 92 files. Sampled ~12 flagged files by hand; all examined were false positives -- the same short literal (a filename like 'roadmap-integration.sh', a word like "absent", a command name) simply quoted multiple times in normal technical prose, not a genuine mandated-literal-vs-absence-assertion contradiction. No genuine instance found in the sample.

RECALL: FAIL (known positive not detected). PRECISION: FAIL (0 genuine of ~12 sampled flagged files, far below the 50% threshold). BOUNDEDNESS: FAIL (92 flagged files >> 5-file threshold -- 'an advisory nobody can triage is noise'). GATE OUTCOME: FAIL on all three criteria.

objectives.description: Record gate outcome and measured values
